scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:client-puppet && pnpm run test:e2e:cloudflare && pnpm run test:e2e:node
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --parallel --filter='!@wskit/website' run typecheck
scripts.depcruise: depcruise server/src core/src client/src server-adapters/cloudflare/src server-adapters/node/src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
scripts.clean: pnpm -r --parallel run clean && rm -rf node_modules && rm -rf tests-e2e/node_modules && rm -rf .playwright-mcp
scripts.check: pnpm format && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.check:ci: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:check && pnpm test && pnpm depcruise && pnpm bundle-check
